description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+ and Java from 8 to 25
tasks.reason: The project uses Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18, both of which are prohibited under the Acme Corp internal playbook. Java 8, 11, and 17 are end-of-life for internal use, and Spring Boot 2.x must be upgraded to Spring Boot 4.0+. Per the Java upgrade guidelines, since the project uses Spring Boot 2.x, a Spring Boot 4.0+ upgrade task (which includes the Java 25 upgrade) is the correct task type — not a standalone Java upgrade task.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+, upgrade Java from 8 to 25, update pom.xml compiler source/target to 25, migrate from JavaEE (javax.*) to Jakarta EE (jakarta.*) namespaces, and update all dependencies to versions compatible with Spring Boot 4.0+ and Java 25. Target build base image: mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu. Target runtime base image: mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless.
tasks.taskSummary: Upgrade already implemented in repository: Spring Boot upgraded to 4.0.0, Java and compiler settings upgraded to 25, Docker base images updated to OpenJDK 25, and no javax.* references remain in source. Verified with mvn -B test (BUILD SUCCESS).
